This hook is useful for assigning consistent colors based on a string, such as a username or item name. Example import useRandomColor from '@/utils/hooks/useRandomColor' const Example = ({ name }) => { const generateColor = useRandomColor() const { background, text } = generateColor(name) return (
{name}
) } export default Example RETURN DESCRIPTION TYPE DEFAULT generateColor Returns an object with Tailwind CSS background and text color classes based on the input name string. (name: string) => { background: string, text: string } TABLE OF CONTENT Example
